source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-3

procedures.title: Fuel tank filler neck drain hose: position
steps: Route the filler neck drain hose down so its end sits flush with, up to 1/2 inch back from, the edge of the bumperette.

specs.value: flush to 1/2 inch back from edge of bumperette

notes: Figure 5 in the manual shows the Corvette tank and its straps; figure 6 shows the filler neck, cap and drain hose.
